EMBA 5010.title: Frameworks for Strategic Analysis
EMBA 5010.description: Explores economic principles of business strategy and develops an analytic framework for identifying and evaluating alternative strategies.
cilos: Apply the concepts of value creation, capture and added value to make strategic decisions.
Use conceptual tools (e.g. Porters 5 Forces) to analyze an industry.
Identify and articulate sources of competitive advantage.

EMBA 5020.title: Analytical Approach to Uncertainty
EMBA 5020.description: Introduces fundamental probabilistic concepts that enable managers to make critical business decisions in the face of uncertainty.
cilos: Apply tools of probability theory (e.g. decision trees) to help conceptualize and solve decision problems involving risk.
Articulate qualitative principles of decision-making, such as the “flaw of averages”.
Use spreadsheet models to represent and solve managerial decision problems.

EMBA 5030.title: Accounting: Financial Reports, Control and Analysis
EMBA 5030.description: This course provides an overview of the two major areas in accounting: financial accounting and managerial accounting.
cilos: Conduct basic financial statement analysis.
Identify how the three financial statements interrelate.
Interpret data in financial accounts in order to make business decisions.

EMBA 5040.title: Marketing Management
EMBA 5040.description: Introduces the importance of companies being market-driven and customer-focused and presents current theories and practices of marketing management.
cilos: Develop a marketing strategy and a marketing mix that delivers it.
Apply frameworks (e.g. segmentation) to analyze marketing problems.

EMBA 5060.title: Leadership and Organizations
EMBA 5060.description: Focuses on the skills and ideas behind effective leadership: working well with teams, utilizing your personal and organizational resources, making difficult but critical decisions, and negotiating well, all with a broad, multifaceted outlook.
cilos: Apply team-building approaches to create trust, shared vision and reduce interpersonal friction.
Negotiate roles on a team.
Identify common decision biases and use this awareness to improve their own decision-making.

EMBA 5070.title: Statistical Decision Analysis
EMBA 5070.description: Explores the use of sample data for purposes of estimating, predicting, forecasting, and decision-making.
cilos: Construct and interpret Confidence Intervals.
Formulate and test hypotheses.
Apply multiple regression analysis to make business decisions.

EMBA 5080.title: Managerial Finance
EMBA 5080.description: Introduces the basic techniques of finance. Topics include discounting techniques and applications; evaluation of capital expenditures; firm valuation; and the implication of financing decisions for shareholder value creation.
cilos: Assess the desirability and value of corporate assets, investment projects and acquisition targets.
Evaluate investment decisions.
Estimate the cost of capital.
Value a company using discounted cashflow valuation.

EMBA 5090.title: Leadership and Decision Making
EMBA 5090.description: This course provides an introduction to leadership and a managerial overview of the science of decision making. Successful organizations excel by the quality of their offerings and services in the marketplace. Internally, leaders and managers distinguish themselves by the quality of their decisions. Quality decision making is a competence that can be acquired and a discipline that should be practiced. This course offers an overview of leadership concepts and practice and a proven framework including cases for effective decision making.
cilos: Develop leadership skills and knowledge
Improve ability to lead the team in making the best decisions to achieve organizational goals
Provide a decision-making framework tested by many practical situations
Develop ability to articulate, defend decisions, and position for successful implementation
Learn the most effective leadership styles in leading the team to make the best decisions

EMBA 5110.title: Operations Management
EMBA 5110.description: Examines the basic principles and useful tools of managing the production of goods or services.  Emphasizes tools and principles that are equally useful in service and manufacturing sectors.
cilos: Design an operations approach that fits company strategy.
Analyze and evaluate an operational process.
Apply principles of lean operations and supply chain management.

EMBA 5120.title: Accounting for Management Planning and Control
EMBA 5120.description: Details the use of financial information in management. Topics include profitability and performance measurement and activity-based management and decision support.
cilos: Conduct breakeven analysis, identifying cost drivers (e.g. Activity Based Costing).
Create a balanced scorecard to manage their business.
Use management accounting principles to manage their business through capital and operational budgeting decisions.

EMBA 5150.title: Negotiation
EMBA 5150.description: Develops negotiation and dispute resolution skills through simulations set in dyads, groups, and multilateral contexts within and between organizations and across cultures.
cilos: Apply the central concepts of negotiation (e.g. Win-Win, BATNA, ZOPA).
Design an overall strategic plan for a negotiation.
Apply cross-cultural negotiation to resolve conflicts.

EMBA 5160.title: Strategic Marketing Decisions
EMBA 5160.description: Examines topics of new product development, marketing resource allocation, and competitive strategy.  Concepts are reinforced by playing MARKSTRT, a simulation game.
cilos: Apply marketing principles to make dynamic marketing decisions.
Communicate their marketing thinking through a strong marketing plan.

EMBA 5170.title: Law and the Corporate Manager
EMBA 5170.description: Studies the legal environment in which business organizations operate.  Topics include rights of shareholders, director's and officer's liability, mergers, acquisitions, takeovers and securities regulation.
cilos: Apply basic legal concepts to their businesses.
Recognize when and how to use in-house and external counsel.

EMBA 5190.title: Foundations for Strategy Formulation
EMBA 5190.description: Explores economic principles essential for the formulation and evaluation of strategy. Topics include industry analysis, strategic positioning and the boundaries of the firm.
cilos: Analyze how industries change and can be changed by companies.
Analyze the steps that organizations should take in order to be more successful as they navigate growth and change.
Identify which activities should be done by the firm and which should be outsourced.

EMBA 5320.title: Deal Making in China and Asia
EMBA 5320.description: The course offers participants the opportunity to strategize and be the decision maker in practical, real-world business situations throughout the Asia Pacific region, including China and India, which illustrate successful and unsuccessful deal-making strategies in Asia.
cilos: Craft deals through negotiations focused on a value-creating process.
Understand the domestic strategic objectives of the key players in China and Asia.
Formulate and apply practical, deal-making strategies to real-world transactions.

EMBA 5400.title: Crisis Management
EMBA 5400.description: Explores crisis management from the point of view of managers and consultants.  Understands the motivations and strategic capabilities of stakeholders, and the importance of value-based management in preventing and managing corporate crises.
cilos: Scan their business practices for reputational, political and regulatory risks.
Design reputation management strategies and processes.
Develop approaches for managing stakeholders, public opinion, media relations and public officials.

EMBA 5420.title: Macroeconomics
EMBA 5420.description: The purpose of this course is to provide a framework for addressing issues about the global economic environment.  It will then apply the framework to understanding the global economy.  It will introduce important insights in the labor, money and foreign exchange markets.
cilos: Identify the frameworks and tools of macroeconomics.
Apply these frameworks and tools to current global macroeconomic issues.

EMBA 5460.title: Understanding Consumers
EMBA 5460.description: This course will give participants an appreciation of how getting inside the mind of the consumer enables the marketing manager to design better effective marketing strategies, with a particular emphasis on effective communication tactics.  This course provides both a micro and macro perspective on the factors influencing a customer.
cilos: Develop effective managerial marketing strategies.
Examine the theory and research concerning the psychology of the consumer, with the goal of understanding how marketing managers can use these ideas.
Assess the appropriate use of consumer behavior concepts, logical development of conclusions and implications.

EMBA 5580.title: Digital Marketing
EMBA 5580.description: The objectives of this course are to 1) provide participants with an understanding of the impact of digital and social networks on customer behavior and marketing strategies 2) share conceptual frameworks and analytical tools for formulating and implementing marketing strategies 3) help participants understand best practices in digital marketing through cases, exercises and examples.
cilos: Generate customer insights and understand customer motives.
Accelerate marketing execution through Agile Marketing.
Apply Artificial Intelligence in marketing.

EMBA 5590.title: International Growth
EMBA 5590.description: The why and the how of corporate international growth will be analyzed throughout the course. In a world fixated by "globalization", the most fundamental questions for companies planning and managing their overseas growth will be examined. Successes and failures will be discussed in order to understand what management teams must do to get international growth right.
cilos: Manage international growth in the era of scale insurgency.
Plan and assess a company’s international growth plan for likelihood of success.
Connect the actions of growth with the talent and organization models.

EMBA 5620.title: Private Equity in Asia
EMBA 5620.description: Provides an overview of private equity, underwriting methods and various details in structuring. Focus will be put on the Asian market. The course is taught by the head of an Asian private equity platform.
cilos: Acquire a general understanding of private equity origination, due intelligence approach, deal structuring and valuation methods.
Identify potential sources of value in private, public, and closely-held firms.
Conduct venture capital and private equity transactions applying analytical framework and tools.

EMBA 5630.title: Managerial Finance II
EMBA 5630.description: The course deals with firm valuation and the implication of financing decisions for shareholder value creation. Topics covered include sources of financing and the process of raising capital, capital structure, firm valuation, leverage and cost of capital, and cash distribution policy.
cilos: Assess the optimum capital structure for a company.
Value a company using discounted cashflow valuation.
Apply principles of valuation to make value creating decisions in PE and M&A situations.

EMBA 5640.title: Strategic Decisions in Operations
EMBA 5640.description: The goal of the course is to understand how strategic decisions in operations impact the performance of the firm. The key will be to understand the link between operations configurations, the customer experience, and the financial performance of the firm.
cilos: Design an operational strategy linking operations, financials and the customer experience.
Assess the attractiveness of a firm’s operating system.
Evaluate whether to build or buy supply chain competences.

EMBA 5660.title: Capstone
EMBA 5660.description: This course is intended as a capstone for students' Executive MBA experience. Students will develop an integrated understanding of business planning and strategy and test strategies in a competitive environment.
cilos: Integrate their accumulated knowledge to analyze how different topics fit together in a C-level perspective.
Formulate a company strategy and execute it through multiple complex tactical decisions.

EMBA 5680.title: Microeconomics
EMBA 5680.description: The course will focus on the economic forces that determine the extent to which businesses can capture the value that they create.
cilos: Construct a fact-based, logically grounded analysis of a competitive market that will allow them to make educated conjectures about the likely path of prices in that market.
Identify the categories of cost relevant for critical business decisions.
Construct models of how government interactions shape the determination of prices and the distribution of value in competitive markets.
Make profit maximizing pricing decisions based on cost and demand fundamentals.

EMBA 5690.title: Applied Mergers and Acquisitions
EMBA 5690.description: Applied Mergers and Acquisitions is designed to prepare executives to succeed as members of an M&A project team. It takes the perspective of a company involved in M&A, not investment bankers or private equity.
cilos: Generate merger and acquisition plan to achieve corporate strategy.
Identify and mitigate the weaknesses of businesses and to bolster their combined strengths.
Identify commercial terms dynamics in negotiation.

EMBA 5700.title: Strategic Human Resources Management
EMBA 5700.description: Most organizations declare their employees to be among their most valuable assets, yet an examination of their systems and practices show inconsistencies in the management of this valuable asset. This course is designed to provide a basic understanding of five key challenges that general managers face in managing their human resources.
cilos: Explain, compare, and apply basic HRM concepts and techniques.
Critically analyze current HRM issues affecting organizations as well as defend feasible, well-thought-out solutions.
Develop fundamental knowledge, skills, and attitudes associated with the HRM profession.

EMBA 5710.title: Leading a Global Company
EMBA 5710.description: The focus of this class is to provide a thorough understanding of what is involved in leading a global company. Through a combination of lectures, cases and readings, the class will discuss and debate the key ingredients required to establish and manage a global company.
cilos: Apply the critical leadership foundation “bricks” to their own leadership role.
Design management processes critical to running a global company.
Apply the principles of Values-Based Management to their future leadership development plan.

EMBA 5720.title: Value Investing
EMBA 5720.description: This course will systematically present the fundamental tenets of value investing: search; valuation; and the construction of a portfolio. It will also introduce the styles of famous value investors and discuss the basic similarities and differences between them. The course is intended for 'active' investors who are willing and able to devote significant amount of time to continually research, select and monitor stocks.
cilos: Identify the fundamental philosophy, style and tools of value investing.
Apply concepts in Accounting, Microeconomics and Corporate Finance to analyze companies and their stocks.
Demonstrate research report writing and presentation skills.

EMBA 5740.title: New Venture Discovery
EMBA 5740.description: The course focuses on the 'customer discovery' process, often referred to as "Phase Zero" in the innovation process. This is perhaps the most important moment in the life of a business. This is designed to help participants identify opportunities and then improve the quality of their ideas, whether they want to pursue an entrepreneurial path or innovate inside an existing firm.
cilos: Identify the process of translating problems into viable products or services.
Articulate a proposed solution in the form of a value proposition.
Develop a rigorous set of hypotheses to test with customers.
Implement the process of “customer development”, being evidence, not assumption-driven.
Develop human-centered research and design techniques.
Construct business model and prototype (using the Business Model Canvas).
Effectively articulate a business model and offer to key constituents.

EMBA 5760.title: Managing Emerging Technologies
EMBA 5760.description: This course provides a managerial overview of new technological innovations such as Internet of Things, big data analytics, AI, FinTech, blockchain, and cryptocurrencies. We will go through the technological foundation of these new developments and how they connect with each other to transform businesses. The course will conclude with practical advice on how to strategically utilize and manage these new technological innovations.
cilos: Identify the properties and trends of emerging technologies.
Compare and contrast different data analytic techniques, AI, and their strategic or managerial values.
Characterize the FinTech landscape and opportunities and related technology development.
Explain the key features of blockchain and its design principles.
Compare and contrast the purposes of blockchain payment transactions and smart contracts.
Characterize initial coin offering (ICO) and its business and social values.

EMBA 6000.title: Special Topics
EMBA 6000.description: The course intends to explore an array of emerging business topics which business students should be made aware of. Students may repeat the course for credit as long as the topics covered are different.
cilos: Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of the concepts and theories on each special topic.
Apply the frameworks from class to real life by communicating complex ideas related to the topic in professional and other settings.
Develop an interest and appreciation of the intricacies in new emerging business topics.
